name: ethos-cli
title: Ethos CLI
description: The official Ethos command-line tool (`ethos`): query profiles, scores, XP, reviews, vouches, markets, validators and more from Ethos's public API. Also installs an ethos-cli skill for AI coding agents.

services.name: ethos-api
services.purpose: Every command reads Ethos's public API: api.ethos.network, or api.dev.ethos.network with ETHOS_ENV=dev. `ethos login` signs in through app.ethos.network and stores the API key it mints in ~/.config/ethos/credentials.json

services.name: npm
services.purpose: Publishes @trust-ethos/cli by trusted publishing (OIDC) from the release workflow, so no npm token

services.name: homebrew-tap
services.purpose: The release workflow updates Formula/ethos.rb in trust-ethos/homebrew-tap

secrets.name: HOMEBREW_TAP_TOKEN
secrets.from: A GitHub Actions secret on this repo: a token that can push to trust-ethos/homebrew-tap, used only by the release workflow

notes: A CLI people install, not a deployed service, so Fleet has nothing to health-check. Released by .github/workflows/release.yml on a push to main when package.json's version has no tag yet: a draft GitHub release, npm publish, tarballs for macOS, Linux and Windows, and the Homebrew formula. Install with the curl script in the README, `npm install -g @trust-ethos/cli` or `brew install trust-ethos/tap/ethos`. ETHOS_ENV, ETHOS_API_URL, ETHOS_DEBUG and ETHOS_OUTPUT (.env.sample) are optional settings, not secrets. ETHOS_API_KEY is each user's own key, overriding the one `ethos login` stored; the repo holds none.
